annotations.title: Discover deals for the shopper's interests

description: Deal browsing with no specific product or store named (categories, interests, gift ideas, "what's on sale", "a good deal on a TV", "running shoes under $150"). A named product or brand, even "a deal on AirPods": use find_product_coupons; a named store: find_coupons. Browsing or categories: interests (non-sensitive) with quick: true; several categories in parallel, one quick call each. A named store: store alone. Never mix the two. Present as a short curated edit with each pick's match_reason.

category.description: Optional: the product's category in McClipFace's taxonomy, so results stay in it inferred from what the shopper means, never from a keyword (honey for the pantry: grocery; honey face wash: beauty); omit when unsure. One of: asian-fashion, audio, auto, bags, beauty, bedding, cleaning, computers, education, electronics, eyewear, fashion, fragrance, furniture, gaming, garden, gifts-food, golf, grocery, grooming, haircare, health, home, home-decor, home-improvement, household-essentials, j-beauty, japanese-fashion, jewelry, k-beauty, kitchen, korean-fashion, makeup, marketplace, office-supplies, oral-care, otc-medicine, personal-care, pets, phones, photo-editing, photo-printing, photography, skincare, smart-home, software, sports-outdoors, toys-kids, travel. A close name is mapped to the nearest one; an unknown one is ignored.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code, uppercase (default USD). Only offers in this currency are returned (USD leaves out non-US stores).

general.description: True for the general selection (no search terms).

keywords.description: Products, brands or interests, e.g. ["Sony camera"]. Leave out categories and keywords for general deals.

limit.description: Number of deals, 1-20 (default 10); one store's deals, 1-100 (default 25).

quick.description: True for a fast answer in seconds: the most promising deals only. Use it when browsing or for one category of several.

store.description: Optional: a named store's current deals (send it alone, no search terms).

name: discover_deals
title: Discover deals for the shopper's interests
